local_iocs.notes: Original packed PE32 GUI sample submitted for analysis.
Decoded 1728-byte first-stage shellcode (PEB-walking API resolver, embedded second-stage loader).
Decoded 335872-byte second-stage raw data containing an embedded PE at offset 0xB30C (header requires reconstruction).

claims.claim_text: The sample is a custom-packed binary with an obfuscated entry gate, self-modifying import table, and a single custom XOR+byteswap decode loop (sub_401B84).
The packer decodes a first-stage x86 shellcode that PEB-walks to kernel32.dll and hash-resolves kernel32 APIs.
The stage-1 shellcode embeds a XOR+bswap-encoded second-stage PE and loads it via a manual PE loader (section mapping, relocation, import resolution).
The original packer stub performs GlobalFlags(NULL) anti-debug checks at multiple sites (sub_401038, sub_401624, sub_40172C, sub_4018E0, sub_401B38, sub_401E38).
No family attribution or embedded configuration (C2, paths) was identified from local static analysis of the packed sample.
Local dynamic analysis could not observe C2, persistence, or network IOCs because the second-stage PE never loaded (decode destination in an uncommitted MEM_RESERVE region).
